name: sections-09
description: Leadership list with gradient initials and expandable bios via disclosure rows.

import { Plus } from "lucide-react" const leaders = [ { name: "Ingrid Solberg", role: "Chief Executive Officer", since: "Co-founder, 2018", tone: "from-sky-400 to-indigo-500", bio: "Previously ran payments infrastructure at a Nordic neobank, where she scaled settlement from 2 to 31 countries. Studied applied mathematics in Trondheim.", }, { name: "Marcus Adeyemi", role: "Chief Technology Officer", since: "Co-founder, 2018", tone: "from-emerald-400 to-teal-600", bio: "Wrote the first version of our ledger in a weekend. Before that, a decade building trading systems and one failed hardware startup he still talks about.", }, { name: "Yuki Tanabe", role: "VP Product", since: "Joined 2020", tone: "from-rose-400 to-orange-400", bio: "Leads a product org of 40 across four time zones. Obsessed with onboarding funnels and allergic to roadmaps longer than one quarter.", }, { name: "Carolina Reyes", role: "VP People", since: "Joined 2021", tone: "from-violet-400 to-fuchsia-500", bio: "Built our four-day-week pilot and the levelling framework every engineer now uses. Former labour economist.", }, { name: "Owen Gallagher", role: "Chief Financial Officer", since: "Joined 2023", tone: "from-amber-400 to-yellow-600", bio: "Took two fintechs through audits and one through an IPO. Runs the monthly all-hands finance review in plain English.", }, ] const initials = (name: string) => name .split(" ") .map((part) => part[0]) .join("") export default function Sections09() { return (

Every leader still ships something each quarter, whether it is code, a policy or a customer call recap.
